# tiny-pkg

A tiny package used as a docs-worker test fixture. It exposes a `greet`
function and a `UserService` for managing `User` records.

## Usage

Call `greet` with a `User` to get a greeting string.

## Discriminated unions

`UserKind` is a discriminated union you can narrow on. Discriminated unions
let you narrow a `User` by its `kind` field.

## UserService

The `UserService` class manages users. Use `UserService.list()` to enumerate
all users.
